assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area geometry is scaffold-derived from the repository’s provisional source and is not an official boundary.
assumptions.impact: Recompute geometry, metrics, drawings, and visual references after official data or final upstream geometry is available.

assumptions.statement: The Frozen Design Spec fixes framework, personas, scenario titles, and drawing identifiers, but full cards, storyboard, drawings, technical controls, and source evidence remain incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Only frozen design logic may be stated as PROPOSAL. Existing-condition and statutory claims remain FACT / UNKNOWN / TO VERIFY according to evidence governance.
